    Shipping Policy – Empress Clothing

    At Empress Clothing, we ensure safe and timely delivery of your favorite ethnic wear across India and worldwide. Please read our shipping policy carefully before placing your order.

    Domestic Shipping (India)

    • Free Shipping: We offer free shipping on all orders within India.
    • Orders are shipped using trusted partners like DTDC, Delhivery, BlueDart, Shree Tirupati Courier, and others.

    International Shipping

    • Flat Rate: USD $20 for most countries (some exceptions apply).
    • Free International Shipping: Orders over USD $249 qualify for free shipping (exceptions apply).
    • International orders are shipped via reliable carriers like FedEx, UPS, DHL, Aramex, etc.

    Customs Duties & Taxes

    Please note that VAT, customs taxes, and import duties are not included in our shipping cost. These charges are the customer’s responsibility and depend on the rules of your country. Empress Clothing has no control over these charges and cannot predict the amount.

    Estimated Shipping Time

    • Unstitched / Semi-Stitched / Free Size: Dispatch within 1–3 working days.
    • Readymade Size & Custom Size Orders: Dispatch within 3–5 working days (Pakistani dresses may take an extra 2–3 days).

    Urgent Orders

    If you need your order urgently, please contact us immediately via WhatsApp or email. We will try our best to prioritize your order.

    • WhatsApp: +91 88 66 20 53 04
    • Email: info@empress-clothing.com

    Shipping Delays

    We aim to deliver your order on time, but delays can occur due to out-of-stock items, tailoring requirements, courier delays, or customs clearance. In such cases:

    • We will notify you via email.
    • No refunds, returns, exchanges, or replacements for delays beyond our control.

    Contact Us

    For any shipping-related questions, please reach out:

    • Phone / WhatsApp: +91 88 66 20 53 04
    • Email: info@empress-clothing.com

    FAQs

    Do you offer free shipping?

    Yes, we offer free shipping within India and free international shipping on orders above USD $249 (exceptions apply).

    How long does delivery take?

    Dispatch time is 1–3 days for unstitched or semi-stitched items and 3–5 days for custom or readymade sizes. Delivery time varies by location.

    Will I have to pay customs fees?

    Custom duties, VAT, and import charges (if applicable) must be paid by the customer as per their country’s regulations.

    Returns, Refunds & Exchanges

    • All sales are final. We do not accept returns for change of mind or sizing issues.
    • Exchanges are allowed only if you receive an incorrect product or a completely defective item.
    • You must report any issue within 24 hours of delivery with clear photos.
    • Resolution process: Exchange first → Store Credit → Refund (rare, at our discretion).
    • Non-returnable: Stitched products, including readymade sizes and custom-size orders.
    • Return shipping cost: If a return or exchange is approved, the customer is responsible for return shipping charges.
    • Color variations due to photography or screen settings are not considered a defect.
    • Pakistani Suits Disclaimer:
      • We provide 100% original branded Pakistani suits, but slight differences from model photos may occur.
      • Accessories (tassels, hangings, frills, buttons, embroidery patches) shown in images may not always be included; these are for display purposes only.
      • Neckline depth will be stitched to a standard modest depth, not necessarily as shown in model images.
      • Color shade variations due to lighting/photography are not considered defects.
      • If you receive an incorrect or completely damaged Pakistani suit, you are eligible for a return or exchange (minor damages will be repaired or exchanged by customer only).
      • Quality concerns: Empress Clothing is a reseller of original branded dresses and does not manufacture them. Dissatisfaction with fabric, finishing, or quality is not eligible for return, exchange, or refund.

    Divine Pearl White Bridal Tone Silk Lehenga Choli by Empress

    This Breathtaking Pearl White Bridal Lehenga Choli by Empress features luxurious bridal tone silk fabric with unparalleled artistry. The pristine pearl shade showcases heavy embroidery with shimmering sequins, delicate thread work, elegant pearls, and intricate zari weaving. The complete ensemble includes two matching dupatta styles - one delicate net and one rich banarasi weaving, plus a heavily embroidered bridal silk blouse with sequins and pearl embellishments.

    Created exclusively for dulhans and brides, this divine masterpiece represents purity and bridal magnificence. Style it with traditional gold jewelry, precious accessories, and regal elements to achieve a heavenly bridal appearance that will make you look absolutely radiant and blessed on your most sacred wedding day.

    Enhance your bridal look with this Pearl White Bridal Silk Sabyasachi Inspired Lehenga Choli from Empress Clothing. Order yours today and get ready to shine on your special day.
